ratings_why.fun: Four clear builds that each grow the knot a different way, and Gossip makes mixing in other tribes pay; the cost is a lot of rules to hold during a fight.
ratings_why.distinct: Earns 8 over 7 because damage moving along the knot changes what Shield, Damage Reduction and every 'takes damage' card do, which no tribe today touches; the shared Health pool and the Piper's untie add to that.

verdict_why: The core reads well now, but Supper Sniffer, Gossip and the Piper each leave one rules question a player can't answer from the card.

points.text: Supper Sniffer doesn't say whether a unit can copy a keyword its neighbour has only just copied, or whether neighbours outside the Knot count. Say 'printed keywords of the Knot units next to it'.
Gossip doesn't say which Knot counts: the one when a gain happened, or the one at End of Turn. Say 'units in its Knot at End of Turn', so moving a unit in late is a clear choice.
The Piper's 'your largest Knot' has no rule for two Knots of the same size. Add a tie-break, for example the one that comes first in reading order.
Taster Wendelin doesn't say what happens to the cheaper, Tied unit if you refresh or freeze. Say whether the mark stays.
The Thirty-Two has the longest text in the tribe. A short keyword such as 'Shared Health' with reminder text would make the card readable at a glance.

standouts.why: Old Gundel reads in one line and gets the most out of split damage: one big hit tickles the whole knot into laughing back.
Town-Hall Bell-Ringer turns the council into a real vote you can steer by shaping the knot.
The Piper makes the one tune the knot fears into a clear late choice: stay tied or let him lead everyone into a free first swing.

weakest.why: Loyal Cagemate is a plain deathrattle body; it doesn't show the cagemate-rescuing idea in what it does.
Cold-Shed Tangle is a generic summon-a-token seed.
Little Fips's doubling clause adds reading for a small Tier 1 bonus.

flags.note: Doesn't say whether copied keywords chain along the Knot, or whether neighbours outside it count.
Gossip doesn't say when Knot membership is checked.
With Old Gundel, units that can't die keep gaining Attack until the pool runs out.
Golden Ilse gives every Gossip unit the full gain, so one Ooze Eat or Fairy Ring feeds every Gossip unit in full.
